title: I asked AI to predict the next crypto to 100x

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Hey, did you know AI just called this crypto the next 100x play?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: We're in a bull run, and investors are desperate for the next big move.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It's a blockchain project called Solace, built on Ethereum.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re using zero-knowledge proofs to make transactions completely private.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could disrupt DeFi by making it safer and more anonymous.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Privacy is the next big frontier in crypto.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you checked out Solace yet?
